Gross profit reached EUR 18.8 million, compared with EUR 5.4 million in 2024, and the gross margin increased to 35% from 30%.

Earnings per share improved to EUR 0.22 from a loss of EUR 0.06.
Cash generated from operating activities was EUR 10.8 million, compared with EUR 10.4 million used in 2024.
